name: Gyro Gym
tagline: Tilt, shake and buzz: a test bench for your phone's motion sensors.
description: A workout for the DashyHQ app's Game kit. The Lab shows live motion readings, graphs, the real sample rate, a bubble level and a 3D phone; the Kit panel tries every haptic and screen control; the Maze is a tilt-to-roll marble game. Works in any browser, best in the DashyHQ app.
